title: Stop pasting tool output into the prompt

hooks.text: Every tool call your agent makes pastes thousands of tokens of noise into its memory. A new paper says: stop.
What if an AI agent never read its tool results as text?
This trick cut an agent's token bill by up to 89 percent and made it more accurate.

verified_claims: Agents usually append raw tool outputs to context; long noisy observations add overhead and dilute attention
Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens embedded in the agent's input embedding space
Action-Preserving Training aligns next-action distributions under full and compressed observations
Web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families: token consumption reduced 70.01% to 89.24%, end-to-end runtime reduced 24.45% to 55.97%, task performance consistently improved
Authors Yuetong Liu et al., Tsinghua University; code released on GitHub
